title: Cryo-EM with AI-based modelling identifies endogenous protein complexes from cell extracts
summary: Native 60S pre-ribosome, fatty acid synthase and PDH/OGDH E2 cores were resolved at 3.84-4.52 A from fewer than 3000 micrographs and compared with purified counterparts. AI is one step in the structural workflow.
ai_technology: AI-based atomic modelling and de novo sequence identification applied to cryo-EM maps

evidence.tested: Cryo-EM maps; comparison to purified counterparts
evidence.unknown: Abstract only; AI is one step in structural workflow; full text not reviewed.
